title: LanceDB engine literal-faithfulness inventory
finding: `accept-lancedb-filter-policy-exception` evidence. On lancedb 0.37.1, the engine's literal builder mis-serialises exactly the two known value classes (apostrophe runs collapse `''` to one apostrophe; backslash-before-apostrophe emits `\'` undoubled) and no others. `translate_where` refuses both classes, accepts all 27 ordinary values with zero false refusals, and live-table equality filters match only their own row (28/28 pass). Supports ADR-058 (LanceDB filter policy exception)
